entry.title: Herrenchiemsee New Palace

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped standing New Palace way 4605747. The open court, park and nearby buildings remain independent.

entry.note: The standing New Palace wraps around an open gravel court. The west garden front has the grand order, three levels of windows and a continuous balustrade with urns. The east court has a columned balcony, three arches, the clock and winged crest, and a striped stone landing. A 535.7 m sea-level model datum and standard terrain support the foundation, two terraces and graded gravel court. The replacement uses the named palace outline. The original garden basins, paths, surrounding buildings and elevation stay in the viewer. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
